host.cpu_reference: 2 x Intel Xeon Gold 6338; SMT not modeled
host.gpu_host_reference: Dell PowerEdge R750xa class, 4 V100-class PCIe accelerators; representative not OEM-certified SKU

assumptions.hardware: Reference architecture and equalized utilization; no Alibaba machine reconstruction or placement/VRAM/SMT model. GPU-equivalent sharing is ideal fluid capacity.
assumptions.power: 205 W CPU TDP and 250 W GPU board rating are reference design endpoints, not measured full-load watts. GPU 25 W idle is paper precedent. CPU idle, DIMM endpoints, chassis/switch and PSU values are engineering assumptions, not manufacturer measurements.
assumptions.thermal: All thermal mass, UA, pressure drops, efficiencies, sizing margin, approaches and fan reference fraction are explicit uncalibrated engineering assumptions. Reduced Carnot air-cooled chiller; no water tower, humidity/economizer, leakage-temperature or spatial hot-spot model.
assumptions.data: Preserve processed annual lineage and known duplicate rows; usage is not reservation; deadlines synthetic; use existing role-checked Train only; do not unpickle annual data.
